hypothesis: Data-quality fix: strict noise-band min_periods silently deletes late-day GC decisions; relax to 90% window and re-baseline
kill_test: Relaxation is non-causal, breaks engine<->engine2 parity, or the recovered decisions materially change the NO-GO verdict
primary_metric: decision-point recovery + revised per-day gross/net Sharpe & t-stat @0.50tick
result_summary: ACCEPTED as revised baseline. Relaxed to min_periods=ceil(0.9*90)=81: band coverage now uniform ~97.8%. Baseline 2641->2692 trades, net Sharpe 0.46->0.48, gross t 2.11->2.17; verdict UNCHANGED NO-GO. Causal, parity re-verified bit-exact (2692 trades / 974.60 pt).
notes: Conservative defect (deleted signals, no lookahead/fill artifact); supersedes EXP-0000 baseline numbers; EXP-0001..0004 used strict bands - re-open on relaxed bands only. Added RULES.md rule 9a + reports/DATA_QUALITY.md
